item.title: Death notice: Kathy Gardner
item.description: Kathy Gardner, 77, of Sterling, Alaska, passed away on Jan. 28, 2026. Born May 16, 1948, to August and Frankie Nordmeyer, Kathy spent the last 45 years building a life in the state she dearly loved. She was preceded in death by her parents; her beloved first husband, James W. Walters II; and her husband, Frank “Mike” Gardner. item.title: The taste of a happy childhood
item.description: My son pulled his shirt on for school this morning, and I was shocked to see exposed wrists and a bare strip of belly — his shirt was suddenly too small. He has another loose tooth, he doesn’t need his step stool to reach the bathroom sink anymore, and he can climb up into his lofted bed with one step instead of three.
